name: A taxonomy that divides the whole space
useWhen: Three to five named classes between them exhaust a space — channel types, data types, engagement modes — and the members of each matter less than the fact that the classes cover everything.

focal.note: The class names carry the slide; the members are supporting detail set at body size. Inverting that ratio turns a taxonomy into four lists.

replacesNote: Close to ent-logo-rows-6 in shape but not in job: that one pairs categories with logo ART and lives on those images; here the members are words and the class name carries the weight.

deviations.source: three-circle Venn inside a radial dial with an arrow loop
deviations.why: One-off artwork drawn for one argument. Nothing about it generalises, and a template that claimed to carry it would be lying about what it is.

deviations.what: class names printing through their members
deviations.source: SHARED and EARNED both do it
deviations.why: A defect in the source. Its left-hand legend also overlaps itself so badly that two of four labels are unreadable.
